mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedules ( user_id, schedule_date, activity_time, title, description, category, completed, priority, emergency_contact, emergency_contact_name, repeat_cycle, notification_time, location_reminder, location_name, latitude, longitude, location_radius, notes, is_all_day, reminder_sent, emergency_notification_sent, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{activityTime}, #{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{completed}, #{priority}, #{emergencyContact}, #{emergencyContactName}, #{repeatCycle}, #{notificationTime}, #{locationReminder}, #{locationName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{locationRadius}, #{notes}, #{allDay}, #{reminderSent}, #{emergencyNotificationSent}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE schedules SET schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}, activity_time = #{activityTime}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, completed = #{completed}, priority = #{priority}, emergency_contact = #{emergencyContact}, emergency_contact_name = #{emergencyContactName}, repeat_cycle = #{repeatCycle}, notification_time = #{notificationTime}, location_reminder = #{locationReminder}, location_name = #{locationName}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, location_radius = #{locationRadius}, notes = #{notes}, is_all_day = #{allDay}, reminder_sent = #{reminderSent}, emergency_notification_sent = #{emergencyNotificationSent}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
